standard_prerequisites.name: For a glueing pair the f-power torsion of R is unchanged under tensoring with R'
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies R[f^n] tensor R' with R[f^n].

standard_prerequisites.name: The f^n-torsion submodule of R injects into R' for a glueing pair
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the injectivity needed for the Tor vanishing.

core_obligations: The short exact sequence 0 -> R[f^n] -> R -> f^n R -> 0 gives a long exact Tor sequence showing Tor_1^R(R', f^n R) is the kernel of R[f^n] tensor_R R' -> R', so it suffices to prove this map injective (proof lines 25478-25480). By the torsion-completion lemma, valid for the glueing pair, R[f^n] tensor_R R' = R[f^n] (proof lines 25480-25481); under this identification the map is the inclusion R[f^n] -> R', which is injective by the same-f-torsion lemma since (R -> R', f) is a glueing pair (proof lines 25481-25482). Hence Tor_1^R(R', f^n R) = 0 (proof lines 25482-25482).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the injectivity of R[f^n] tensor R' -> R' via the Tor sequence (proof lines 25478-25480).
Identify the tensor product with R[f^n] and use the glueing injectivity (proof lines 25480-25482).
difficulty_reason: 7 行、glueing 对的 Tor_1 零化：0 -> R[f^n] -> R -> f^nR -> 0 的 Tor 长正合列把 Tor_1(R', f^nR) 化为 R[f^n]⊗R' -> R' 的核；torsion-completion 引理给 R[f^n]⊗R' = R[f^n]，same-f-torsion 引理给 R[f^n] -> R' 单射（glueing 对定义），故 Tor 为零。承重全在 span 内；2 处引用作导航桩。
